notes.title: Steel Echoes Expansion Update In Planning
notes.notes:
Hello!

I want to thank everyone who played the game and everyone who gave back feedback about the game.
Having said that I wanted to announce, that I began planning an expansion for Steel Echoes. Stay tuned for more info!

Thank you for your support!
